messages:
mae: kicked off v3.2.5 canary at 14:07 UTC for embed-global. quick note: variant changed to modelx:quant-fast in us-west1 first stage.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed 0% -> 100% in 6m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1729999990 :robot_face:
leo: saw a synthetic prefill heatmap wobble in us-west1 ~+3m, p95 from 60ms -> 410ms briefly. no 5xxs but tail visible.
sre-oncall: runbook threshold: if synth p95 >300ms for >90s OR kv-miss delta >9% during canary, pause and triage.
mae: checking kv metrics — kv-miss delta ~+11% during the blip.
release-manager: what's the blast radius if we pin regionally vs rollback? change window ends in 40m.
leo: regional pin is fastest, low impact. rollback would delay whole change window and rollback migrations. recommend regional pin to fp16 in us-west1 and keep rest rolling.
mae: agreed. running rdctl: `rdctl routes pin --route embed-global --region us-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "canary synth prefill tail spike"`
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rollout id r-2026-03-23-1729.
smoke-bot: scheduled rerun of embed-kv-prefill in us-west1. ETA ~30s.
smoke-bot: results: pre-pin p95 412ms, kv-miss +11% -> post-pin p95 110ms, kv-miss +2% :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: holding global rollout paused for 20m observation per runbook. please add short release note and a follow-up ticket for quant-fast warmup ordering.
release-manager: added to release notes: "v3.2.5: us-west1 temporarily pinned to fp16 due to post-deploy synthetic prefill tail; investigation open." Also nudged change window owners — we keep the window but won't stage new regions until safe.
mae: filing tracker: PERF-7712 with traces and smoke logs. attaching link here: https://tracker.redwood.internal/PERF-7712
leo: small follow-up: let's add a quickcheck panel for kv-prefill heatmap to the deploy dashboard so we see these deltas during future windows.
mae: noted. will keep thread open for 25m and close if observation window is clean. :thumbsup:
